regime_context: Canada / TSX shows a broad, non-directional rotation with Oil & Gas Producers leading on cross-sectional rank but carrying a mean-revert durability tag, while Big Banks hold a stronger trend-health leg. Rotation timing is display-only, the headline theme is not a validated predictor, and the macro backdrop is headline-driven (unscheduled_share = 1.0), adding noise; I will keep leans conditional and conviction low.
emerging_watch: Watching for a CONFIRMED leadership handoff from Oil & Gas Producers to Big Banks: retire this watch if ZEB.TO closes at least 2% above XEG.TO over any rolling 10-day window while both remain eligible.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers sit rank #1 with eligibility intact, so the trend-gate leg is the only validated risk-control signal; however durability is mean-revert (0.55) and narrow-ish breadth (0.571), which argues the leadership is thin rather than confirmed. No crowding flag exists. This is a conditional preference only while the absolute-trend gate stays intact.
evidence: Track record dir_accuracy 0.317 — overall directional edge is weak
theses.dissent: Mean-revert durability and rank-IC ~0 momentum mean the leader could easily rotate out; the rotation margin is wide (0.868) but this says nothing about forward returns.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO breaks below its 200-day average before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the challenger with the strongest validated trend-health leg: durability 0.72 (trend) and breadth 0.857 — a much more cohesive thematic leadership structure than the headline leader. Rank lag is modest (score 0.832 vs 1.7), but the trend-gate + breadth combination is the only leg with any staying-power support. This is a relative-preference conditional, not an edge claim.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0; Big Banks lag on raw score and the rotation radar shows no confirmed handoff.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XEG.TO by 4% before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the only eligible theme with a crowding flag (crowding_z 1.37, crowded=true) and carries a rank-edge of -0.018. Guardrails forbid treating crowding as a fade or sell, but the avoid lean is a size-down caution: with weak rank and only trend-health (durability 0.72) in its favour, it offers no leadership reason to add exposure.
evidence: Rank #10 — attention not with this theme
theses.dissent: Trend-health is strong (0.72) and breadth is decent; crowding is coincident, not a validated sell trigger.
